column1: # OpenCode Go worker roster for go-worker and ~/.claude/rules/pstack-go.md.
# A pstack role names a worker as go/<alias>. go-worker resolves the alias to the
# OpenCode Go model id. `go-worker doctor` checks every id against the live
# https://opencode.ai/inference/go/v1/models list. Allowances are the Go plan
# values documented on 2026-11-02 (https://opencode.ai/docs/go/); Go Plus is higher.
